data.text: [00:05]You look terrible. What’s the matter?
[00:08.6]I feel sick and I’ve got stomachache.
[00:17]No … I’ve got flu. I’ve got a high temperature and a headache.
[00:27]How you are? You don’t look well.
[00:30.7]I’ve got a cough and sore eyes. I don’t think it’s serious – I’ve got a cold. That’s all.
[00:46]No. I’ve got terrible backache and my leg hurts. I’ve got toothache today as well.
[01:00.5]Terrible! I’ve got a sore throat and earache. I’ve got a rash as well.
